children.text: namo 'cintyādbhutākliṣṭajñānavairāgyarāśaye |
children.translated_text: Homage to the Lord, the sage, who is a treasury of inconceivable, wondrous, and unafflicted knowledge and dispassion,

children.text: nāthāya munaye 'gādhabhagavadbhaktisindhave ||
children.translated_text: to <s>Nātha</s>, the sage, who is an unfathomable ocean of devotion to the <s>Bhagavān</s>.

children.text: namo 'cintya-adbhuta-akliṣṭa-jñāna-vairāgya-rāśaye |
nāthāya munaye 'gādha-bhagavad-bhakti-sindhave ||
tasmai namo madhujidaṅghrisarojatattvajñānānurāgamahimātiśayāntasīmne |
children.translated_text: Homage to him, to <s>Nāthamuni</s>, who is the ultimate limit of the greatness of loving devotion to the truth of the lotus feet of the slayer of <s>Madhu</s>,

children.text: nāthāya nāthamunaye 'tra paratra cāpi nityaṃ yadīyacaraṇau śaraṇaṃ madīyam ||
children.translated_text: to <s>Nātha</s>, to <s>Nāthamuni</s>, whose two feet are my eternal refuge, here and hereafter.

children.text: tasmai namo madhujid-aṅghri-saroja-tattva-jñāna-anurāga-mahima-atiśaya-antasīmne |
nāthāya nātha-munaye 'tra paratra ca api nityaṃ yadīya-caraṇau śaraṇaṃ madīyam ||
bhūyo namo 'parimitācyutabhaktitattvajñānāmṛtābdhiparivāhaśubhair vacobhiḥ |
children.translated_text: Again, homage, through words that are the auspicious outflow of a nectarean ocean of knowledge of the truth of limitless devotion to <s>Acyuta</s>,

children.text: loke 'vatīrṇaparamārthasamagrabhaktiyogāya nāthamunaye yamināṃ varāya ||
children.translated_text: to <s>Nāthamuni</s>, the best among ascetics, through whom the yoga of complete supreme devotion descended into the world.

children.text: bhūyo namo 'parimita-acyuta-bhakti-tattva-jñāna-amṛta-abdhi-parivāha-śubhair vacobhiḥ |
loke 'vatīrṇa-parama-artha-samagra-bhakti-yogāya nātha-munaye yamināṃ varāya ||
tattvena yaś cidacidīśvaratatsvabhāvabhogāpavargatadupāyagatīr udāraḥ |
children.translated_text: To him who, noble one, revealed in truth the natures of <s>cit</s> (consciousness), <s>acit</s> (matter), and <s>Īśvara</s> (the Lord), and the paths of enjoyment, liberation, and the means thereto,

children.text: saṃdarśayan niramimīta purāṇaratnaṃ tasmai namo munivirāya parāśarāya ||
children.translated_text: who produced the jewel of the <s>Purāṇa</s> — homage to that chief among sages, <s>Parāśara</s>.

children.text: tattvena yaś cid-acid-īśvara-tat-svabhāva-bhoga-apavarga-tad-upāya-gatīr udāraḥ |
saṃdarśayan niramimīta purāṇa-ratnaṃ tasmai namo muni-virāya parāśarāya ||
mātā pitā yuvatayas tanayā vibhūtiḥ sarvaṃ yad eva niyamena madanvayānām |
children.translated_text: Mother, father, young wives, sons, wealth — all that my lineage possesses without exception,

children.text: ādyasya naḥ kulapater vakulābhirāmaṃ śrīmat tadaṅghriyugalaṃ praṇamāmi mūrdhnā ||
children.translated_text: the auspicious pair of feet of the first patriarch of our family, adorned with <s>Vakula</s> flowers — I bow my head to them.

children.text: mātā pitā yuvatayas tanayā vibhūtiḥ sarvaṃ yad eva niyamena mad-anvayānām |
ādyasya naḥ kula-pater vakula-abhirāmaṃ śrīmat tad-aṅghri-yugalaṃ praṇamāmi mūrdhnā ||
yan mūrdhni me śrutiśirassu ca bhāti yasminn asmanmanorathapathaḥ sakalaḥ sameti |
children.translated_text: That which shines upon my head and in the <s>Upaniṣads</s> (the crown of the <s>Vedas</s>), in which all the paths of our desires come together,

children.text: stoṣyāmi naḥ kuladhanaṃ kuladaivataṃ tat pādāravindam aravindavilocanasya ||
children.translated_text: I shall praise it — the treasure and family deity of our clan — the lotus feet of the lotus-eyed Lord.

children.text: yan mūrdhni me śruti-śirassu ca bhāti yasminn asman-mano-ratha-pathaḥ sakalaḥ sameti |
stoṣyāmi naḥ kula-dhanaṃ kula-daivataṃ tat pāda-āravindam aravinda-vilocanasya ||
tattvena yasya mahimārṇavaśīkarāṇuḥ śakyo na mātum api śarvapitāmahādyaiḥ |
children.translated_text: He whose greatness in truth cannot be measured even by <s>Śarva</s> (Śiva), <s>Pitāmaha</s> (Brahmā), and others, even as an atom to an ocean,

children.text: kartuṃ tadīyamahimastutim udyatāya mahyaṃ namo 'stu kavaye nirapatrapāya ||
children.translated_text: to me, a shameless poet, who has undertaken to compose a praise of His greatness — let there be homage to me!

children.text: tattvena yasya mahima-arṇava-śīkara-aṇuḥ śakyo na mātum api śarva-pitāmaha-adyaiḥ |
kartuṃ tadīya-mahima-stutim udyatāya mahyaṃ namo 'stu kavaye nirapatrapāya ||
yad vā śramāvadhi yathāmati vāpy aśaktaḥ staumy evam eva khalu te 'pi sadā stuvantaḥ |
children.translated_text: Or rather, to the limit of my effort and according to my understanding, though incapable, I praise thus; indeed, they too always praise in the same manner —

children.text: vedāś catur mukhamukhāś ca; mahārṇavāntaḥ ko majjator aṇukulācalayor viśeṣaḥ ? ||
children.translated_text: the four <s>Vedas</s> and those spoken by the four-faced one (<s>Brahmā</s>). What difference is there between an atom and a small mountain when both are drowning in the great ocean?

children.text: yad vā śrama-avadhi yathā-mati va āpy aśaktaḥ staumy evam eva khalu te 'pi sadā stuvantaḥ |
vedāś catur mukha-mukhāś ca; mahā-arṇava-antaḥ ko majjator aṇu-kula-acalayor viśeṣaḥ ? ||
kiṃ caiṣa śaktyatiśayena na te 'nukampyaḥ stotāpi tu stutikṛtena pariśrameṇa |
children.translated_text: Moreover, the one who praises is not to be pitied by You on account of any excess of power, but rather for the effort made in composing the praise.

children.text: tatra śramas tu sulabho mama mandabuddher ity udyamo 'yam ucito mama cābjanetra ! ||
children.translated_text: That effort, however, is easily come by for me, whose intellect is dull — therefore this undertaking is fitting for me, O lotus-eyed one!

children.text: kiṃ ca eṣa śakty-atiśayena na te 'nukampyaḥ stota āpi tu stuti-kṛtena pariśrameṇa |
tatra śramas tu sulabho mama manda-buddher ity udyamo 'yam ucito mama ca abja-netra ! ||
nāvekṣase tyadi tato bhuvanāny amūni nālaṃ prabho bhavitum eva kutaḥ pravṛttiḥ ? |
children.translated_text: If You did not look upon these worlds, they would not be able even to exist — whence then any activity, O Lord?

children.text: evaṃ nisargasuhṛdi tvayi sarvajantâüḥ svāmin ! citram idam āśritavatsalatvam ||
children.translated_text: Thus, O Master, for all beings You are by nature a friend — how wonderful is this tenderness toward those who take refuge in You!

children.text: na avekṣase tyadi tato bhuvanāny amūni na alaṃ prabho bhavitum eva kutaḥ pravṛttiḥ ? |
evaṃ nisarga-suhṛdi tvayi sarva-jantâüḥ svāmin ! citram idam āśrita-vatsalatvam ||
svābhāvikānavadhikātiśayeśitṛtvaṃ nārāyaṇa ! tvayi na mṛṣyati vaidikaḥ kaḥ ? |
children.translated_text: O <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>! Which follower of the <s>Vedas</s> would deny Your natural, unlimited, and supremely excellent lordship?

children.text: brahmā śivaḥ śatamakhaḥ paramasvarāḍ ity ete 'pi yasya mahimārṇavavipraṣas te ||
children.translated_text: <s>Brahmā</s>, <s>Śiva</s>, <s>Śatamakha</s> (Indra), and <s>Paramasvarāṭ</s> (the supreme self-ruler) — even these are but drops from the ocean of Your greatness.

children.text: svābhāvika-anavadhika-atiśaya-īśitṛtvaṃ nārāyaṇa ! tvayi na mṛṣyati vaidikaḥ kaḥ ? |
brahmā śivaḥ śatamakhaḥ parama-sva-rāḍ ity ete 'pi yasya mahima-arṇava-vipraṣas te ||
kaś śrīḥ śriyaḥ ? paramasattvasamāśrayaḥ kaḥ ? kaḥ puṇḍarīkanayanaḥ ? puruṣottamaḥ kaḥ ? |
children.translated_text: Who is <s>Śrī</s> (the goddess of beauty)? The beauty of beauties. Who is the supreme refuge of <s>sattva</s> (goodness)? Who is the lotus-eyed one? Who is the <s>Puruṣottama</s> (Supreme Person)?

children.text: kasyāyutāyutaikakalāṃśakāṃśe viśvaṃ vicitracidacitpravibhāgavṛttam ||
children.translated_text: In a fraction of a fraction of a fraction of whose ten-thousandth part, the entire universe operates with its wondrous division of <s>cit</s> (conscious) and <s>acit</s> (unconscious).

children.text: kaś śrīḥ śriyaḥ ? parama-sattva-samāśrayaḥ kaḥ ? kaḥ puṇḍarīka-nayanaḥ ? puruṣottamaḥ kaḥ ? |
kasya ayuta-ayuta-eka-kalāṃśaka-aṃśe viśvaṃ vicitra-cidacit-pravibhāga-vṛttam ||
vedāpahāragurupātakadaityapīḍāpadvimocanamahiṣṭhaphalapradānaiḥ |
children.translated_text: Through rescuing the <s>Vedas</s> from theft, delivering from the great sins of the preceptor, relieving the afflictions of the <s>Daityas</s>, liberating from calamities, and granting the most excellent fruits —

children.text: ko 'nyaḥ prajāpaśupatī paripāti ? kasya pādodakena sa śivaḥ svaśirodhṛtena ? ||
children.translated_text: who else protects the lord of beings and the lord of creatures? By whose foot-water does that <s>Śiva</s> purify himself, bearing it on his head?

children.text: veda-apahāra-guru-pātaka-daitya-pīḍa-āpad-vimocana-mahiṣṭha-phala-pradānaiḥ |
ko 'nyaḥ prajā-paśu-patī paripāti ? kasya pāda-udakena sa śivaḥ sva-śiro-dhṛtena ? ||
kasyodare haraviriñcamukhaḥ prapañcaḥ ? ko rakṣatīmam ? ajaniṣṭa ca kasya nābheḥ ? |
children.translated_text: In whose belly is the universe with <s>Hara</s> (Śiva) and <s>Viriñca</s> (Brahmā) at its head? Who protects this [world]? And from whose navel was it born?

children.text: krāntvā nigīrya punar udgirati tvadanyaḥ kaḥ ? kena vaiṣa paravān iti śakyaśaṅkaḥ ? ||
children.translated_text: Who else but You, having stridden over [all], swallowed, and again disgorged [the universe]? By whom is this one suspected of being subordinate?

children.text: kasya udare hara-viriñca-mukhaḥ prapañcaḥ ? ko rakṣati imam ? aja-niṣṭa ca kasya nābheḥ ? |
krāntvā nigīrya punar udgirati tvad-anyaḥ kaḥ ? kena va aiṣa paravān iti śakya-śaṅkaḥ ? ||
tvāṃ śīlarūpacaritaiḥ paramaprakṛṣṭasattvena sāttvikatayā prabalaiś ca śāstraiḥ |
children.translated_text: Through Your character, beauty, conduct, supremely excellent <s>sattva</s>, Your <s>sāttvika</s> nature, and through powerful <s>śāstras</s> (scriptures),

children.text: prakhyātadaivaparamārthavidāṃ mataiś ca naivāsuraprakṛtayaḥ prabhavanti boddhum ||
children.translated_text: and through the views of those renowned for knowing the supreme truth about the divine — those of <s>āsura</s> (demonic) nature are unable to know You.

children.text: tvāṃ śīla-rūpa-caritaiḥ parama-prakṛṣṭa-sattvena sāttvikatayā prabalaiś ca śāstraiḥ |
prakhyāta-daiva-parama-artha-vidāṃ mataiś ca na eva asura-prakṛtayaḥ prabhavanti boddhum ||
ullaṅghitatrividhasīmasamātiśāyisaṃbhāvanaṃ tava paribraḍhimasvabhāvam |
children.translated_text: Your nature, whose magnitude surpasses all imagination, exceeding the threefold boundary,

children.text: māyābalena bhavatāpi niguhyamānaṃ paśyanti kecid aniśaṃ tvadananyabhāvāḥ ||
children.translated_text: though concealed even by You through the power of <s>Māyā</s> — some who are devoted to You alone see it always.

children.text: ullaṅghita-trividha-sīma-sama-atiśāyi-saṃbhāvanaṃ tava paribraḍhima-svabhāvam |
māyā-balena bhavata āpi niguhyamānaṃ paśyanti kecid aniśaṃ tvad-ananya-bhāvāḥ ||
yad aṇḍam aṇḍāntaragocaraṃ ca yaddaśottarāṇy āvaraṇāni yāni ca |
children.translated_text: The cosmic egg and all that is within it, the ten successively greater envelopes,

children.text: guṇāḥ pradhānaṃ puruṣaḥ paraṃ padaṃ parāt paraṃ brahma ca te vibhūtayaḥ ||
children.translated_text: the <s>guṇas</s> (qualities), <s>Pradhāna</s> (primal matter), <s>Puruṣa</s> (spirit), the supreme abode, and <s>Brahman</s> beyond the beyond — these are Your manifestations.

children.text: yad aṇḍam aṇḍa-antara-gocaraṃ ca yad-daśa-uttarāṇy āvaraṇāni yāni ca |
guṇāḥ pradhānaṃ puruṣaḥ paraṃ padaṃ parāt paraṃ brahma ca te vibhūtayaḥ ||
vaśī vadānyo guṇavān ṛjuḥ śucir mṛdur dayālur madhuraḥ sthiraḥ samaḥ |
children.translated_text: Self-controlled, generous, virtuous, straightforward, pure, gentle, compassionate, sweet, steadfast, impartial,

children.text: kṛtī kṛtajñas tvam api svabhāvataḥ samastakalyāṇaguṇāmṛtodadhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: accomplished, grateful — You are, by Your very nature, a nectarean ocean of all auspicious qualities.

children.text: vaśī vadānyo guṇavān ṛjuḥ śucir mṛdur dayālur madhuraḥ sthiraḥ samaḥ |
kṛtī kṛta-jñas tvam api svabhāvataḥ samasta-kalyāṇa-guṇa-amṛta-udadhiḥ ||
upary upary abjabhuvo 'pi pūruṣān prakalpya te ye śatam ity anukramāt |
children.translated_text: Even if one were to create, in ascending succession, a hundred persons above <s>Brahmā</s> (the lotus-born one),

children.text: giras tvad ekaikaguṇāvdhīpsayā sadā sthitā nodyamato 'tiśerate ||
children.translated_text: their words, ever engaged in the desire to [praise] each one of Your qualities, would never surpass [them] even with effort.

children.text: upary upary abja-bhuvo 'pi pūruṣān prakalpya te ye śatam ity anukramāt |
giras tvad eka-eka-guṇa-avdhīpsayā sadā sthitā na udyamato 'tiśerate ||
tvadāśritānāṃ jagadudbhavasthitapraṇāśasaṃsāravimocanādayaḥ |
children.translated_text: For those who depend on You, the creation, maintenance, and destruction of the world, liberation from <s>saṃsāra</s> (cyclic existence), and such —

children.text: bhavanti līlāvidhayaś ca vaidikās tvadīyagambhīramano'nusāriṇaḥ ||
children.translated_text: these are Your playful acts, according to the <s>Vedas</s>, following Your profound will.

children.text: tvad-āśritānāṃ jagad-udbhava-sthita-praṇāśa-saṃsāra-vimocana-ādayaḥ |
bhavanti līlā-vidhayaś ca vaidikās tvadīya-gambhīra-mano-'nusāriṇaḥ ||
namo namo vāṅmanasātibhūmaye namo namo vāṅmanasaikabhūmaye |
children.translated_text: Homage, homage to Him who transcends the realm of speech and mind! Homage, homage to Him who is the sole realm of speech and mind!

children.text: namo namo 'nantamahāvibhūtaye namo namo 'nantadayaikasandhive ||
children.translated_text: Homage, homage to Him of infinite, great glory! Homage, homage to Him whose sole nature is infinite compassion!

children.text: namo namo vāṅ-manasā-atibhūmaye namo namo vāṅ-manasā-eka-bhūmaye |
namo namo 'nanta-mahā-vibhūtaye namo namo 'nanta-dayā-eka-sandhive ||
na dharmaniṣṭho 'smi, na cātmavedī, na bhaktimāṃs tvaccaraṇāravinde |
children.translated_text: I am not established in <s>dharma</s>, nor am I a knower of the <s>Ātman</s>, nor do I have devotion to Your lotus feet;

children.text: akiñcano 'nanyagatiḥ śaraṇya ! tvatpādamūlaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye ||
children.translated_text: possessing nothing, having no other refuge, O worthy of refuge! I take shelter at the base of Your feet.

children.text: na dharma-niṣṭho 'smi, na cā atma-vedī, na bhaktimāṃs tvac-caraṇa-āravinde |
akiñcano 'nanya-gatiḥ śaraṇya ! tvat-pāda-mūlaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye ||
na ninditaṃ karma tad asti loke sahasraśo yan na mayā vyadhāyi |
children.translated_text: There is no blameworthy deed in the world that I have not performed a thousand times over;

children.text: so 'haṃ vipākāvasare mukunda ! krandāmi sampraty agatis tavāgre ||
children.translated_text: such am I, O <s>Mukunda</s>, and now, at the time of retribution, without any recourse, I cry before You.

children.text: na ninditaṃ karma tad asti loke sahasraśo yan na mayā vyadhāyi |
so 'haṃ vipāka-avasare mukunda ! krandāmi sampraty agatis tava agre ||
nimajjato 'nanta ! bhavārṇavāntaś cirāya me kūlam ivāsi labdhaḥ |
children.translated_text: O <s>Ananta</s> (Infinite One)! Sinking for so long within the ocean of <s>saṃsāra</s>, You have been found by me like a shore;

children.text: tvayāpi labdhaṃ bhagavann idānīm anuttamaṃ pātram idaṃ dayāyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: and You too, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, have now obtained this supreme vessel of compassion.

children.text: nimajjato 'nanta ! bhava-arṇava-antaś cirāya me kūlam iva asi labdhaḥ |
tvaya āpi labdhaṃ bhagavann idānīm anuttamaṃ pātram idaṃ dayāyāḥ ||
abhūtapūrvaṃ mama bhāvi kiṃ vā sarvaṃ sahe me sahajaṃ hi duḥkham |
children.translated_text: What unprecedented thing will befall me? I endure all — for suffering is innate to me.

children.text: kiṃ tu tvadagre śaraṇāgatānāṃ parābhavo nātha ! na te 'nurūpaḥ ||
children.translated_text: But, O Lord, the humiliation of those who have taken refuge before You is not befitting of You!

children.text: abhūta-pūrvaṃ mama bhāvi kiṃ vā sarvaṃ sahe me sahajaṃ hi duḥkham |
kiṃ tu tvad-agre śaraṇāgatānāṃ parā-bhavo nātha ! na te 'nurūpaḥ ||
nirāsakasyāpi na tāvad utsahe maheśa ! hātuṃ tava pādapaṅkajam |
children.translated_text: Even though You reject me, O Great Lord, I am unable to abandon Your lotus feet;

children.text: ruṣā nirasto 'pi śiśuḥ stanandhayo na jātu mātuś caraṇau jihāsati ||
children.translated_text: even a nursing child, though pushed away in anger, never wishes to leave its mother's feet.

children.text: nirāsakasya api na tāvad utsahe maheśa ! hātuṃ tava pāda-paṅkajam |
ruṣā nirasto 'pi śiśuḥ stanandhayo na jātu mātuś caraṇau jihāsati ||
tavāmṛtasyandini pādakaṅkaje niveśitātmā katham anyad icchati |
children.translated_text: How can one whose self is fixed upon Your lotus feet, which drip with nectar, desire anything else?

children.text: sthite 'ravinde makarandanirbhare madhuvrato nekṣurakaṃ hi vīkṣate ||
children.translated_text: When it rests upon a lotus overflowing with honey, the bee does not look at the sugarcane.

children.text: tava-amṛta-syandini pāda-kaṅkaje niveśita-ātmā katham anyad icchati |
sthite 'ravinde makaranda-nirbhare madhu-vrato na ikṣurakaṃ hi vīkṣate ||
tvadaṅghrim uddiśya kadāpi kenacid yathā tathā vāpi sakṛt kuto 'ñjaliḥ |
children.translated_text: Whoever, at any time, however, even once, for whatever reason, offers salutation directed toward Your feet —

children.text: tadaiva muṣṇāty aśubhāby aśeṣataḥ śubhāni puṣṇāti na jātu hīyate ||
children.translated_text: that very act immediately destroys all inauspicious things completely and nourishes all that is auspicious; it never diminishes.

children.text: tvad-aṅghrim uddiśya kada āpi kenacid yathā tathā va āpi sakṛt kuto 'ñjaliḥ |
tada aiva muṣṇāty aśubhāby aśeṣataḥ śubhāni puṣṇāti na jātu hīyate ||
udīrṇasaṃsāradavāśuśukṣaṇiṃ kṣaṇena nirvāpya parāṃ ca nirvṛtim |
children.translated_text: A single spray from the nectarean ocean of love for Your two rosy lotus feet, in an instant quenching the blazing fire of the raging <s>saṃsāra</s>,

children.text: prayacchati tvaccaraṇāruṇāmbujadvayānurāgāmṛtasindhuśīkaraḥ ||
children.translated_text: bestows supreme bliss.

children.text: udīrṇa-saṃsāra-dava-aśuśukṣaṇiṃ kṣaṇena nirvāpya parāṃ ca nirvṛtim |
prayacchati tvac-caraṇa-āruṇa-ambuja-dvaya-anurāga-amṛta-sindhu-śīkaraḥ ||
vilāsavikrāntaparāvarālayaṃ namasyadārtikṣapaṇe kṛtakṣaṇam |
children.translated_text: Your lotus foot, whose sport-like stride encompasses the higher and lower worlds, which is ever ready to remove the suffering of those who bow to it,

children.text: dhanaṃ madīyaṃ tava pādapaṅkajaṃ kadā nu sākṣātkaravāṇi cakṣuṣā ? ||
children.translated_text: my treasure — when shall I behold it directly with my eyes?

children.text: vilāsa-vikrānta-para-avara-ālayaṃ namasyad-ārti-kṣapaṇe kṛta-kṣaṇam |
dhanaṃ madīyaṃ tava pāda-paṅkajaṃ kadā nu sākṣāt-karavāṇi cakṣuṣā ? ||
kadā punaḥ śaṅkharathāṅgakalpakadhvajāravindāṅkuśavajralāñchanam |
children.translated_text: When shall Your pair of lotus feet, O <s>Trivikrama</s>, marked with the conch, discus, wish-fulfilling tree, banner, lotus, goad, and thunderbolt,

children.text: trivikrama ! tvaccaraṇāmbujadvayaṃ madīyamūrdhānam alaṅkariṣyati ||
children.translated_text: adorn my head?

children.text: kadā punaḥ śaṅkha-rathāṅga-kalpaka-dhvaja-āravinda-aṅkuśa-vajra-lāñchanam |
trivikrama ! tvac-caraṇa-ambuja-dvayaṃ madīya-mūrdhānam alaṅkariṣyati ||
virājamānojjvalapītavāsasaṃ smitātasīsūnasamāmalacchavim |
children.translated_text: Resplendent in brilliant yellow garments, with a flawless complexion like the flower of a blooming <s>atasī</s> (flax), surpassed by a smile,

children.text: nimagnanābhiṃ tanumadhyamunnataṃ viśālavakṣassthalaśobhilakṣaṇam ||
children.translated_text: with a deep navel, a slender waist, a raised [chest], with an auspicious mark adorning a broad chest,

children.text: virājamāna-ujjvala-pīta-vāsasaṃ smita-atasī-sūna-sama-amala-cchavim |
nimagna-nābhiṃ tanu-madhya-munnataṃ viśāla-vakṣas-sthala-śobhi-lakṣaṇam ||
cakāsataṃ jyākiṇakarkaśaiḥ śubhaiś caturbhir ājānuvilambhir bhuhaiḥ |
children.translated_text: shining with four auspicious arms, hanging down to the knees, rough with bowstring calluses,

children.text: priyāvataṃsotpalakarṇabhūṣaṇaślathālakābandhavimardaśaṃsibhiḥ ||
children.translated_text: bearing witness to the loosened hair-bands from the play with the beloved's tilaka ornament and lotus ear-ornaments,

children.text: cakāsataṃ jyā-kiṇa-karkaśaiḥ śubhaiś caturbhir ājānu-vilambhir bhuhaiḥ |
priya-avataṃsa-utpala-karṇa-bhūṣaṇa-ślatha-alakā-bandha-vimarda-śaṃsibhiḥ ||
udagrapīnāṃsavilambikuṇḍalālakāvalībandhurakanbukandharam |
children.translated_text: with a conch-like neck, beautiful with hanging earrings and rows of curls on high, full shoulders,

children.text: mukhaśriyā nyakkṛtapūrṇanirmalāmṛtāṃśubimbāmburuhojjvalaśriyam ||
children.translated_text: whose facial beauty surpasses the radiance of the full, spotless, nectarean moon and the brilliant lotus,

children.text: udagra-pīna-aṃsa-vilambi-kuṇḍala-alaka-avalī-bandhura-kanbukandharam |
mukha-śriyā nyakkṛta-pūrṇa-nirmala-amṛta-aṃśu-bimba-amburuha-ujjvala-śriyam ||
prabuddhamugdhāmbujacārulocanaṃ savibhramabhrūlatam ujjvalādharam |
children.translated_text: with beautiful eyes like blooming, charming lotuses, with playful arching brows, with radiant lips,

children.text: śucismitaṃ komalagaṇḍam unnasaṃ lalāṭaparyantavilambitālakam ||
children.translated_text: with a pure smile, tender cheeks, a high nose, and curls falling to the forehead,

children.text: prabuddha-mugdha-ambuja-cāru-locanaṃ savibhrama-bhrūlatam ujjvala-adharam |
śuci-smitaṃ komala-gaṇḍam unnasaṃ lalāṭa-paryanta-vilambita-alakam ||
sphuratkirīṭāṅgadahārakaṇḍhikāmaṇīndrakāñcīguṇanūpurādibhiḥ |
children.translated_text: resplendent with a shining crown, armlets, necklace, choker, the king of jewels, girdle, anklets, and other ornaments,

children.text: rathāṅgaśaṅkhāsigadādhanurvarair lasattulasyā vanamālayojjvalam ||
children.translated_text: brilliant with the discus, conch, sword, mace, bow, and choice weapons, and with a shining <s>Tulasī</s> garland and a forest garland,

children.text: sphurat-kirīṭa-aṅgada-hāra-kaṇḍhikā-maṇi-indra-kāñcīguṇa-nūpura-ādi-bhiḥ |
ratha-aṅga-śaṅkha-asi-gadā-dhanur-varair lasat-tulasyā vanamālaya-ujjvalam ||
cakartha yasyā bhavanaṃ bhujāntaraṃ tava priyaṃ dhāma yadīyajanmabhūḥ |
children.translated_text: she whose dwelling You have made the space between Your arms, she whose birthplace is Your beloved abode,

children.text: jagatsamastaṃ yadapāṅgasaṃśrayaṃ yadartham ambhodhir amanthy abandhi ca ||
children.translated_text: by whose side-glance the entire world is sustained, for whose sake the ocean was churned and bound —

children.text: cakartha yasyā bhavanaṃ bhuja-antaraṃ tava priyaṃ dhāma yadīya-janma-bhūḥ |
jagat-samastaṃ yad-apāṅga-saṃśrayaṃ yad-artham ambhodhir amanthy abandhi ca ||
svavaiśvarūpyeṇa sadānubhūtayāpy apūrvavadvismayamādadhānayā |
children.translated_text: with her, who though always experienced through Your divine majesty, produces wonder as if for the first time,

children.text: guṇena rūpeṇa vilāsaceṣṭitais sadā tavaivocitayā tava śriyā ||
children.translated_text: with Your <s>Śrī</s> (Lakṣmī), ever befitting You alone in qualities, form, playful deeds, and gestures —

children.text: sva-vaiśvarūpyeṇa sadā-anubhūtaya āpy apūrvavad-vismaya-māda-dhānayā |
guṇena rūpeṇa vilāsa-ceṣṭitais sadā tava eva ucitayā tava śriyā ||
tayā sahāsīnam anantabhogini prakṛṣṭavijñānabalaikadhāmani |
children.translated_text: seated with her upon the infinite serpent-couch, the sole abode of supreme knowledge and power,

children.text: phaṇāmaṇivrātamayūkhamaṇḍalaprakāśamānodaradivyadhāmani ||
children.translated_text: whose divine abode is illuminated by the radiance of the circle of rays from the crest-jewels of the hoods,

children.text: tayā saha-asīnam ananta-bhogini prakṛṣṭa-vijñāna-bala-eka-dhāmani |
phaṇā-maṇi-vrāta-mayūkha-maṇḍala-prakāśamāna-udara-divya-dhāmani ||
nivāsaśayyāsanapādukāṃśukopadhānavarṣātapavāraṇādibhiḥ |
children.translated_text: who, through the different forms of his body serving as dwelling, bed, seat, sandals, parasol, cushion, shelter from rain and sun, and such,

children.text: śarīrabhedais tava śeṣatāṃ gatair yathocitaṃ śṣa itīrite janaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: has attained the state of being Your servant — and is therefore called <s>Śeṣa</s> (the 'Remainder') by the people, as is fitting,

children.text: nivāsa-śayyāsana-pāduka-aṃśuka-upadhāna-varṣa-ātapa-vāraṇa-ādibhiḥ |
śarīra-bhedais tava śeṣatāṃ gatair yathā-ucitaṃ śṣa itī irite janaiḥ ||
dāsas sakhā vāhanam āsanaṃ dhvajo yas te vitānaṃ vyajanaṃ trayīmayaḥ |
children.translated_text: he who is Your servant, friend, vehicle, seat, banner, and canopy, Your fan, who is the embodiment of the three <s>Vedas</s> —

children.text: upasthitaṃ tena puro garutmatā tvadaṅghrisammardakiṇāṅkaśobhanā ||
children.translated_text: standing before You is he, <s>Garutmat</s> (Garuḍa), beautiful with the marks of calluses from pressing Your feet.

children.text: dāsas sakhā vāhanam āsanaṃ dhvajo yas te vitānaṃ vyajanaṃ trayī-mayaḥ |
upasthitaṃ tena puro garutmatā tvad-aṅghri-sammarda-kiṇa-aṅka-śobhanā ||
tvadīyabhuktojjihitaśeṣabhojinā tvayā nisṛṣṭātmabhareṇa yadyathā |
children.translated_text: By Your beloved commander-in-chief, who eats the remnants left over from Your meals, to whom You have entrusted the burden of Yourself —

children.text: priyeṇa senāpatinā nyavedi tattathānujānantam udāravīkṣanaiḥ ||
children.translated_text: whatever was reported by him in whatever manner, that You acknowledged with gracious glances.

children.text: tvadīya-bhukta-ujjihita-śeṣa-bhojinā tvayā nisṛṣṭa-ātma-bhareṇa yad-yathā |
priyeṇa senāpatinā nyavedi tat-tathā-anujānantam udāra-vīkṣanaiḥ ||
hatākhilakleśamalaiḥ svabhāvatas tvadānukūlyaikarasais tavocitaiḥ |
children.translated_text: By ministers whose every defilement of affliction has been destroyed, who are by nature of the sole flavor of being favorable to You, who are fit for You,

children.text: gṛhītatattatparicārasādhanair niṣevyamāṇaṃ sacivair yathocitaṃ ||
children.translated_text: who have taken up the respective implements of service — You are served as is befitting.

children.text: hata-akhila-kleśa-malaiḥ svabhāvatas tvad-ānukūlya-eka-rasais tava-ucitaiḥ |
gṛhīta-tat-tat-paricāra-sādhanair niṣevyamāṇaṃ sacivair yathā-ucitaṃ ||
apūrvanānārasabhāvanirbhadraprabaddhayā mugdhavidaghalīlayā |
children.translated_text: With sport that is both naively charming and elegantly sophisticated, tightly bound by ever-new and wondrous moods,

children.text: kṣaṇāṇuvat kṣiptaparādikālayā praharṣayantaṃ mahiṣīṃ mahābhujanam ||
children.translated_text: casting away ages and eons like mere moments—[I meditate upon] the mighty-armed one who delights his queen.

children.text: apūrva-nānā-rasa-bhāva-nirbhadra-prabaddhayā mugdha-vidagha-līlayā |
kṣaṇa-aṇuvat kṣipta-para-ādi-kālayā praharṣayantaṃ mahiṣīṃ mahābhujanam ||
acintyadivyādbhutanityayauvanasvabhāvalāvaṇyamayāmṛtodadhim |
children.translated_text: An ocean of nectar consisting of inconceivable, divine, wondrous, eternal youth and natural beauty,

children.text: śriyaḥ śriyaṃ bhaktajanaikajīvitaṃ samartham āpatsakham arthikalpakam ||
children.translated_text: the beauty of <s>Śrī</s>'s own beauty, the sole life of devotees, the capable friend in calamity, the wish-fulfilling tree for supplicants—

children.text: acintya-divya-adbhuta-nitya-yauvana-svabhāva-lāvaṇya-maya-amṛta-udadhim |
śriyaḥ śriyaṃ bhakta-jana-eka-jīvitaṃ samartham āpat-sakham arthi-kalpakam ||
bhagavantam evānucaran nirantaraṃ praśāntaniśśeṣamanorathāntaraḥ |
children.translated_text: constantly following the <s>Bhagavān</s> (Lord) alone, with all other desires within the mind completely pacified,

children.text: kadāham aikāntikanityakiṅkaraḥ praharṣayiṣyāmi sanāthajīvitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: when shall I, an exclusive and eternal servant, with my life fulfilled, delight [Him]?

children.text: bhagavantam eva anucaran nirantaraṃ praśānta-niśśeṣa-manoratha-antaraḥ |
kada āham aikāntika-nitya-kiṅkaraḥ praharṣayiṣyāmi sanātha-jīvitaḥ ||
dhig aśucim avinītaṃ nirbhayaṃ mām alajjaṃ paramapuruṣa yo 'ham yogivaryāgragaṇyaiḥ |
children.translated_text: Shame on me—impure, undisciplined, fearless, shameless—I who, O Supreme Person, am extremely far from being meditated upon by the foremost among the best <s>yogins</s>,

children.text: vidhśivasanakādyair dhyātum atyantadūraṃ tava parijanabhāvaṃ kāmaye kāmavṛttaḥ ||
children.translated_text: by <s>Vidhi</s> (<s>Brahmā</s>), <s>Śiva</s>, <s>Sanaka</s> and others—yet I, governed by desire, desire the status of your servant!

children.text: dhig aśucim avinītaṃ nirbhayaṃ mām alajjaṃ parama-puruṣa yo 'ham yogi-varya-agra-gaṇyaiḥ |
vidh-śiva-sanaka-ādyair dhyātum atyanta-dūraṃ tava parijana-bhāvaṃ kāmaye kāma-vṛttaḥ ||
aparādhasahasrabhājanaṃ patitaṃ bhīmabhavārṇavodare |
children.translated_text: A vessel of a thousand offenses, fallen into the belly of the terrifying ocean of worldly existence,

children.text: atagiṃ śaraṇāgataṃ hare kṛpayā kevalam ātmasātkuru ||
children.translated_text: helpless, having come to your refuge—O <s>Hari</s>, make me your own by compassion alone.

children.text: aparādha-sahasra-bhājanaṃ patitaṃ bhīma-bhava-arṇava-udare |
atagiṃ śaraṇāgataṃ hare kṛpayā kevalam ātma-sāt-kuru ||
avivekaghanāndhadiṅmukhe bahudhā santataduḥkhavarṣiṇi |
children.translated_text: In the terrible stormy day of worldly existence, where the directions are sealed by dense darkness of ignorance, where manifold continuous rains of suffering pour—

children.text: bhagavan bhavadurdine pathaḥ skhalitaṃ mām avalokayāciyuta ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Bhagavān</s>, O one whose wealth is compassion, look upon me who has stumbled on the path.

children.text: aviveka-ghana-andha-diṅmukhe bahudhā santata-duḥkha-varṣiṇi |
bhagavan bhava-durdine pathaḥ skhalitaṃ mām avalokaya aciyuta ||
na mṛṣā paramārtham eva me śṛnu vijñāpanam ekam agrataḥ |
children.translated_text: It is not false—it is the supreme truth; hear my one petition first:

children.text: yadi me na dayiṣyase tato dayanīyas tava nātha durlabhaḥ ||
children.translated_text: if you will not show mercy to me, then, O Lord, one worthy of your compassion will be hard to find.

children.text: na mṛṣā parama-artham eva me śṛnu vijñāpanam ekam agrataḥ |
yadi me na dayiṣyase tato dayanīyas tava nātha durlabhaḥ ||
tad ahaṃ tvad ṛte na nāthavān mad ṛte tvaṃ dayanīyavān na ca |
children.translated_text: Therefore I have no protector other than you, and you have no one more worthy of compassion other than me;

children.text: vidhinirmitam etam anvayaṃ bhagavān palaya mā sma jīhapaḥ ||
children.translated_text: O <s>Bhagavān</s>, protect this relationship ordained by fate—do not abandon [me]!

children.text: tad ahaṃ tvad ṛte na nāthavān mad ṛte tvaṃ dayanīyavān na ca |
vidhi-nirmitam etam anvayaṃ bhagavān palaya mā sma jīhapaḥ ||
vapurādiṣu yo 'pi ko 'pi vā guṇato 'sāni yathātathāvidhaḥ |
children.translated_text: Whatever or whoever I may be with respect to body and other [attributes], of whatever quality, just as such—

children.text: tad ayaṃ tava pādapadmayor aham adyaiva mayā samarpitaḥ ||
children.translated_text: this very self of mine I have today offered at your lotus feet.

children.text: vapur-ādiṣu yo 'pi ko 'pi vā guṇato 'sāni yathā-tathā-vidhaḥ |
tad ayaṃ tava pāda-padmayor aham adya eva mayā samarpitaḥ ||
mama nātha yad asti yo 'smy ahaṃ sakalaṃ tad dhi tavaiva mādhava |
children.translated_text: O my Lord, whatever I possess and whatever I am—all that is indeed yours alone, O <s>Mādhava</s>;

children.text: niyatasvam iti prabuddhadhīr atha vā kiṃ nu samarpayāmi te ||
children.translated_text: having awakened to the understanding that [I am] your own by nature—what then can I offer to you?

children.text: mama nātha yad asti yo 'smy ahaṃ sakalaṃ tad dhi tava eva mādhava |
niyata-svam iti prabuddha-dhīr atha vā kiṃ nu samarpayāmi te ||
avabodhitavān imāṃ yathā mayi nityāṃ bhavadīyatāṃ svayam |
children.translated_text: Just as you yourself have made known to me this eternal state of belonging to you,

children.text: kṛpayaivam ananyabhogyatāṃ bhagavan bhaktim api prayaccha me ||
children.translated_text: by that same compassion, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, grant me also <s>bhakti</s> (devotion) that is to be enjoyed by no other.

children.text: avabodhitavān imāṃ yathā mayi nityāṃ bhavadīyatāṃ svayam |
kṛpaya aivam ananya-bhogyatāṃ bhagavan bhaktim api prayaccha me ||
tava dāsyasukhaikasaṅghināṃ bhavaneṣu astv api kīṭajanma me |
children.translated_text: Let me have birth even as an insect in the abodes of those whose sole attachment is the joy of service to you;

children.text: itarāvasatheṣu mā sma bhūd api me janma caturmukhātmanā ||
children.translated_text: but let me not have birth even as four-faced <s>Brahmā</s> in other dwellings!

children.text: tava dāsya-sukha-eka-saṅghināṃ bhavaneṣu astv api kīṭa-janma me |
itara-avasatheṣu mā sma bhūd api me janma catur-mukha-ātmanā ||
sakṛt tvadākāravilokanāśayā tṛṇīkṛtānuttamabhuktimuktibhiḥ |
children.translated_text: Lead me to being regarded by those great souls who, with the desire to behold your form even once,

children.text: mahātmabhir mām avalokyatāṃ naya kṣaṇe 'pi te yad viraho 'tidussahaḥ ||
children.translated_text: have counted as trifles the highest enjoyments and liberation—for whom separation from you even for a moment is extremely unbearable.

children.text: sakṛt tvad-ākāra-vilokana-āśayā tṛṇīkṛta-anuttama-bhukti-muktibhiḥ |
mahā-ātmabhir mām avalokyatāṃ naya kṣaṇe 'pi te yad viraho 'tidussahaḥ ||
na dehaṃ na prāṇān na ca sukham aśeṣābhilaṣitaṃ
children.translated_text: Neither body, nor life-breath, nor happiness, nor all that is desired,

children.text: na cātmānaṃ nānyat ki api tava śeṣatvavibhavāt
children.translated_text: nor the self, nor anything else that has gone outside the glory of being your servant—

children.text: bahirbhūtaṃ nātha kṣaṇam api sahe yātu śatadhā
children.translated_text: O Lord, I cannot endure even for a moment. Let it be destroyed a hundredfold.

children.text: vināśaṃ tat satyaṃ madhumathana vijñāpanam idam ||
children.translated_text: This is my true petition, O <s>Madhumathana</s> (Churner of <s>Madhu</s>).

children.text: na dehaṃ na prāṇān na ca sukham aśeṣa-abhilaṣitaṃ
na cā atmānaṃ na anyat ki api tava śeṣatva-vibhavāt
bahir-bhūtaṃ nātha kṣaṇam api sahe yātu śatadhā
vināśaṃ tat satyaṃ madhumathana vijñāpanam idam ||
durantasyānāder apariharaṇīyasya mahato
children.translated_text: Of endless, beginningless, inescapable, great [sin],

children.text: nihīnācāro 'haṃ nṛpaśur aśubhasyāspadam api
children.translated_text: I am a brute among men, of base conduct, the very abode of inauspiciousness—

children.text: dayāsindho bandho niravadhikavātsalyajaladhe
children.translated_text: O ocean of mercy, O kinsman, O sea of boundless affection,

children.text: tava smāraṃ smāraṃ guṇagaṇam itīcchāmi gatabhīḥ ||
children.translated_text: remembering again and again your host of virtues, I thus desire [you], free from fear.

children.text: durantasya anāder apariharaṇīyasya mahato
nihīna-ācāro 'haṃ nṛpaśur aśubhasyā aspadam api
dayā-sindho bandho niravadhika-vātsalya-jaladhe
tava smāraṃ smāraṃ guṇa-gaṇam iti icchāmi gatabhīḥ ||
anicchann apy evaṃ yadi punar itīcchann iva rajastamaśchannac chadmastutivacanabhaṅgīṃ aracayam |
children.translated_text: Even though unwilling, thus if I, as though willing, veiled by <s>rajas</s> (passion) and <s>tamas</s> (darkness), have composed this deceptive composition in the guise of praise,

children.text: tathāpītthaṃrūpaṃ vacanam avalambyāpi kṛpayā tvam evaivambhūtaṃ dharaṇidhara me śikṣaya manaḥ ||
children.translated_text: still, O Bearer of the Earth, relying upon such words as these, by your compassion, train this mind of mine to be truly thus.

children.text: anicchann apy evaṃ yadi punar iti icchann iva rajas-tamaś-channac chadma-stuti-vacana-bhaṅgīṃ aracayam |
tatha āpi itthaṃ-rūpaṃ vacanam avalambya api kṛpayā tvam eva evam-bhūtaṃ dharaṇi-dhara me śikṣaya manaḥ ||
pitā tvaṃ mātā tvaṃ dayitatanayas tvaṃ priyasuhṛt tvam eva tvaṃ mitram gurur asi gatiś cāsi jagatām |
children.translated_text: You are the father, you are the mother, you are the dear son and beloved friend; you indeed are the companion, the teacher, and the refuge of the worlds.

children.text: tvadīyas tvadhbṛtyas tava parijanas tvadgatir ahaṃ prapannaś caivaṃ saty aham api tavaivāsmi hi bharaḥ ||
children.translated_text: I am yours, your servant, your attendant, one whose course is directed to you; and being thus surrendered, I am indeed your burden alone.

children.text: pitā tvaṃ mātā tvaṃ dayita-tanayas tvaṃ priya-suhṛt tvam eva tvaṃ mitram gurur asi gatiś ca asi jagatām |
tvadīyas tvad-hbṛtyas tava parijanas tvad-gatir ahaṃ prapannaś ca evaṃ saty aham api tava eva asmi hi bharaḥ ||
janitvāhaṃ vaṃśe mahati jagati khyaatayaśasāṃ
children.translated_text: Though born in a great lineage in this world of those renowned in fame,

children.text: śucīnāṃ yuktānāṃ guṇapuruṣatattvasthitividām
children.translated_text: of the pure, the devoted, the knowers of the truth of <s>guṇa</s> (quality) and <s>Puruṣa</s> (Supreme Person),

children.text: nisargād eva tvaccaraṇakamalāikāntamanasām
children.translated_text: whose minds by their very nature are exclusively fixed on your lotus feet—

children.text: adho 'dhaḥ pāpātmā śaraṇada nimajjāmi tamasi ||
children.translated_text: I, a sinful soul, O Giver of Refuge, sink lower and lower into darkness.

children.text: janitva āhaṃ vaṃśe mahati jagati khyaata-yaśasāṃ
śucīnāṃ yuktānāṃ guṇa-puruṣa-tattva-sthiti-vidām
nisargād eva tvac-caraṇa-kamala-aikānta-manasām
adho 'dhaḥ pāpa-ātmā śaraṇa-da nimajjāmi tamasi ||
amaryādaḥ kṣudraś calamatir asūyaprasavabhūḥ kṛtaghno durmānī smaraparavaśo vañcanaparaḥ |
children.translated_text: Lawless, petty, fickle-minded, the birthplace of envy, ungrateful, arrogant, enslaved by passion, given to deception,

children.text: nṛśaṃsaḥ pāpiṣṭhaḥ katham aham ito duḥkhajaladher apārād uttīrṇas tava paricareyaṃ caraṇayoḥ ||
children.translated_text: cruel, most sinful—how shall I, having crossed this shoreless ocean of suffering, serve at your feet?

children.text: amaryādaḥ kṣudraś cala-matir asūya-prasava-bhūḥ kṛta-ghno durmānī smara-para-vaśo vañcana-paraḥ |
nṛ-śaṃsaḥ pāpiṣṭhaḥ katham aham ito duḥkha-jala-dher apārād uttīrṇas tava paricareyaṃ caraṇayoḥ ||
raghuvara yad abhūs tvaṃ tādṛśo vāyasasya praṇata iti dayālur yac ca caidyasya kṛṣṇa |
children.translated_text: O best of the <s>Raghus</s>, you who were thus compassionate to the crow because he bowed down; and, O <s>Kṛṣṇa</s>, you who bestowed <s>sāyujya</s> (union) with yourself

children.text: pratibhavam aparāddhur mugdha sāyujyado 'bhūr vada kim apadam āgas tasya te 'si kṣamāyāḥ ||
children.translated_text: upon <s>Caidya</s> (<s>Śiśupāla</s>) who had offended in every birth, O innocent one—tell me, what offense is beyond your capacity for forgiveness?

children.text: raghuvara yad abhūs tvaṃ tādṛśo vāyasasya praṇata iti dayālur yac ca caidyasya kṛṣṇa |
pratibhavam aparāddhur mugdha sāyujyado 'bhūr vada kim apadam āgas tasya te 'si kṣamāyāḥ ||
nanu prapannas sakṛd eva nātha tavāhaṃ asmīti ca yācamānaḥ |
children.translated_text: Is it not so that one who has surrendered even once, O Lord, saying 'I am yours,' and who supplicates—

children.text: tavānukampyas smartaḥ pratijñānāṃ madekavarjaṃ kim idaṃ vrataṃ te ||
children.translated_text: is worthy of your compassion? Remembering your promises, is this your vow—to exclude me alone?

children.text: nanu prapannas sakṛd eva nātha tava ahaṃ asmi iti ca yācamānaḥ |
tava anukampyas smartaḥ pratijñānāṃ mad-eka-varjaṃ kim idaṃ vrataṃ te ||
